shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short && git log -5 --oneline && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,140p' && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && cat package.json | sed -n '1,180p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,145p' && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Fix registry test aggregate assertions" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
